svg.title: principles.md — how I build
svg.desc: Four animated tiles: Deterministic (same input, same output, byte for byte), Explainable (every decision ships with its evidence), Closed contracts (one versioned schema, no silent defaults), Secure by default (mTLS, short-lived credentials, signed reproducible builds).
